name: Suzuki GSX-R750 (1985-1995)
engine: 749 cc oil-cooled (water-cooled from 1992) inline four, four carbs
intro: The first GSX-R750s. Oil-cooled until 1992, four carbs, and a big part of sportbike history.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
E: Oil-cooled GSX-Rs depend on the oil to cool the engine. Use the oil spec in the manual and check the cooler lines for leaks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
